subject: general
question: Which state of India was ruled by the Ningthouja dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Manipur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **descendants of Manipur's kings** make up the **Ningthouja dynasty**, commonly known as the** Mangang dynasty.**
 
• Ningthouja literally translates to **"King's Progeny."**
 
• There are **125 extended families** living there. In **33 CE, King Nongda Lairen Pakhangba** is said to have** founded** it.
 
• Emperor Nongta Lailen Pakhangpa whose identity is often mingled with that of** Pakhangpa, **the serpentine dragon god of Meitei mythology and religion.
 
• The **Ningthouja dynast**y was one of the **three most powerful **dynasties, the others being** Luwang dynasty and Khuman dynasty.**
 
• By the beginning of the** 1st millennium CE**, the Ningthouja Dynasty began to emerge in **Imphal River valley**, overrunning the territory of the** Khaba clan**. They established** Kangla** as their **seat of power.**
